stem: Anjali took 2,400 rupees to a market in Chennai. She bought 3 kilograms of rice at 85 rupees per kilogram and 2 bottles of cooking oil that each cost the same amount. She had 1,465 rupees left. What was the price, in rupees, of one bottle of cooking oil?
solution: The rice cost \(3 \cdot 85 = 255\) rupees. Let \(p\) be the price of one bottle of oil.
verify:
p = symbols('p')
sol = solve(Eq(2400 - 3*85 - 2*p, 1465), p)
assert sol == [340]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
